query: For each movie in records.json, prepare a sentiment review report using ONLY its listed review_ids. Identify clearly positive reviews from their reviewText, return all their review IDs, the positive count, negative count and positivity ratio. Use binary POSITIVE/NEGATIVE overall movie-review sentiment, treating other completed non-positive judgments as NEGATIVE. Do not infer sentiment from the film's reputation. Do not count unlisted reviews in the lake.

task_definition.evidence: lake/reviews.csv contains full reviewText. Join movies.csv on id for titles. reviews.csv includes other movies and unlisted reviews; records.json defines this processing batch.
task_definition.execution_failure: ABSTAIN with null value; do not convert failure into a negative sentiment.
